description: Kernel-enforced protection that restricts root-level modification of protected system paths, kernel extensions, and system processes. Even processes running as root cannot modify /System, /usr (excluding /usr/local), pre-installed Apple applications, or inject code into system processes. Prevents rootkit installation, system file tampering, and kernel extension abuse. SIP is enforced by the kernel and cannot be disabled from within macOS; requires Recovery Mode boot to disable.

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Requires SIP bypass exploit; root privilege insufficient to modify system files
System file modification prevented even with root access; tampering blocked at kernel level
Root privilege retained but system modification rights restricted

verification.method: Verify SIP status and individual protection flags

commands.expected: No output (SIP fully enabled) or csr-active-config=%00%00%00%00

relationships.rationale: Prevents incorrect permission assignment by enforcing mandatory access control on system paths
Prevents incorrect resource transfer between user space and protected system sphere
Reduces privilege scope; root cannot modify protected system resources

framework_bindings.rationale: SIP implements MAC semantics for macOS system resources
